messages:
maya: FYI NovaLedger (CID: 74120) opened a P1. After the canary to v2.13-int4 their automated knowledge-qa outputs are confidently wrong more often — fabricated partners, wrong founding years.

maya: Example A
```
System: You are a company historian.
User: When was NovaLedger founded and who did they partner with in 2019?
Model: "NovaLedger was founded in 2008 and partnered with FinCorp in 2019."
```
(Reality: NovaLedger founded 2015; no FinCorp partnership in 2019.)

novaledger-support: Sending over three more snippets and request IDs. This started right after the EU canary flip at ~09:40 UTC.

leo: Any request IDs so we can trace logs?

novaledger-support: r-9f8e7d6c, r-9f8e7d6d, r-9f8e7d6e. Pasted raw responses into the ticket.

sam: v2.13-int4 was the quantized latency build we rolled canary earlier today. Could be an int4 precision artifact.

maya: Repro: I ran the same prompt locally against v2.13-int4 with temperature=0 and got the fabricated partner. v2.12 (baseline) returns correct info.

leo: Please paste the exact curl so eng-runtime can reproduce.

maya: Curl we used:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: r-9f8e7d6c" \
  -d '{"model":"v2.13-int4","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a company historian."},{"role":"user","content":"When was NovaLedger founded and who did they partner with in 2019?"}],"temperature":0}'
```

aisha: Notifying eng-ml + eng-runtime. CS will offer a goodwill credit and ask for a short mitigation window.

sam: Tagging eval-bot: can you run a targeted comparison on the company-partners & founding-year prompt set across v2.12 vs v2.13-int4 and return precision/recall for factual claims?

eval-bot: Job submitted: eval-job-551. Will ping when complete.

leo: I'll diff the model artifacts and quantize logs for the int4 build. If repro is consistent we can pin NovaLedger to v2.12 while we investigate.

ops-bot: Tenant pin prepared for CID 74120. Needs eng-runtime approval to apply.

sam: Quick triage notes for eng-runtime:
1) Run curl with model=v2.13-int4, temp=0, top_p=1.0.
2) Capture tokenization outputs and logits for the first 40 tokens.
3) Compare tokenization against v2.12 baseline; check embedding drift on factual tokens.
4) Re-run with qkv-emu=true (if available) to isolate quantization path.

maya: Customer: "This is causing incorrect public docs to be generated, we need this fixed urgently." They asked for ETA — offered 24-48h investigation window and temporary routing pin.

aisha: CS ticket CS-8021 created and linked to CID 74120. Offered 72h credit; set expectation of rollback if other tenants show similar regressions.

leo: Labels: regression, quant-int4, customer-critical. I'll post artifact hashes and initial diff soon.

sam: If anyone else gets similar repros drop them into CS-8021. Thanks all. :pray:
